Welcome, {{NAME}}. This is your private workspace for BIOL 4800/7800. Everything
you write this semester lives here.

## Getting started

Click the badge above to launch your Codespace. The first build takes a couple of
minutes; after that it resumes in seconds.

## Getting course materials

From the terminal inside your Codespace:

```
course-get list             # see what's available
course-get lecture 3        # pull lecture 3 into lectures/lecture03/
course-get homework 5       # pull homework 5 into homework/hw05/
```

Files you have already edited are never overwritten. Add `--force` if you want a
clean copy.

## Turning work in

Assignments are submitted through Gradescope, not here. Download your files from
the Codespace file explorer and upload them before the Tuesday 9 AM deadline.
